Module org.apache.jena.core
Package org.apache.jena.mem.collection

Interface JenaSetIndexed<E>

Type Parameters:
E - the element type of the set
All Superinterfaces:
Iterable<E>, JenaMapSetCommon<E>, JenaSet<E>, JenaSetHashOptimized<E>, Sized
All Known Implementing Classes:
FastHashedTripleBunch, FastHashSet, TripleSet, TripleSet
public interface JenaSetIndexed<E> extends JenaSetHashOptimized<E>
Extension of JenaSetHashOptimized that exposes index-based access to elements. Indices are stable handles to entries (returned by addAndGetIndex(Object)) and remain valid until the corresponding entry is removed.

  • Method Details

    • addAndGetIndex

      int addAndGetIndex(E key)
      Add an element and return the index it was stored at. If the element is already present, returns the bitwise complement (~existingIndex) of the existing index, so callers can distinguish "newly inserted" from "already present" while still recovering the index in both cases.
      Parameters:
      key - the element to add. (null is not allowed)
      Returns:
      the new index, or ~existingIndex if already present

    • removeAndGetIndex

      int removeAndGetIndex(E key)
      Remove the given element and return the index it occupied before removal.
      Parameters:
      key - the element to remove
      Returns:
      the former index of the element, or -1 if it was not present
